findings.text: The legend hand-builds handles that do not match what draw_nulls paints: the magnetic axis handle is drawn open (marker="^", markerfacecolor="none", lines 158-163) while nova/media/poloidal.py:606 plots the axis filled, and the admitted X-point handle uses marker "P" (line 168) where draw_nulls paints style.xpoint_marker = "X" (nova/media/ink.py:85). Both docs captions repeat the same wording ('magnetic axis open triangle, admitted X-point filled cross'), which contradicts nova/AGENTS.md's stated vocabulary ('solid triangle for the axis, filled cross for the admitted saddle, hollow markers for other qualified nulls'); a reader matching the legend to the plot sees the axis marked as hollow like the other qualified null when the drawn axis is solid. The data marks themselves are correct, so this does not hold the node.
